summary: Build OmniStream, a YouTube-like video sharing website supporting user-uploaded long videos and shorts, starting empty, with a logo splash/loading screen (including founder/co-founder text), 24-hour max video length, and an optional viewer timer that can pause playback. Add a signed-in-only floating + action button for Upload/Short/Go Live, a simpler clock-style timer setter, a Shorts-specific logo/branding element, and require live streaming delay no longer than 5 seconds. Deploy the website so it is publicly accessible (go live), and configure a custom domain so the final public URL is ommistream.net.
architectural_notes: Guest mode supported: browsing allowed while unauthenticated; uploading/posting requires sign-in.
User requested "no actors" (avoid Motoko actor backend); consider frontend-only/mock/local storage approach for uploads/feeds.
Plan/prepare for deployment so the OmniStream site is publicly accessible (go-live/release workflow).
Custom domain target for public site: ommistream.net (configure DNS + IC boundary nodes / canister routing as needed and document the final URL).
known_issues: User reports posting/uploading currently "won't post now" (upload failing).
Deployed site access failing with "Canister ID Not Resolved" when opening the icp0.io URL (user indicates the deployment link/domain they are using does not resolve).
User cannot see the viewer timer UI on the Watch page (timer feature not visible).
Custom domain www.ommistream.com is not resolving (DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN).

existing_features.title: Create the OmniStream app shell with core navigation and pages for: Home (video feed), Shorts (vertical shorts feed), Upload (post a video/short), and Watch (player page). The site must start with no videos/shorts shown (empty state UI).
Implement authentication using Internet Identity so users can sign in before uploading content; unauthenticated users can browse but cannot upload.

Frontend Upload flow: allow users to upload either a long video or a short, set a title, and provide/confirm the video duration shown to the user before posting. After upload, the new item appears in the appropriate feed (Home for videos, Shorts for shorts).

Implement the Watch experience: play the selected video/short, display current time and total duration, and include a viewer timer users can set while watching. When the timer reaches zero, the player must automatically pause.

Add a splash/loading screen that appears on initial app load and displays the OmniStream logo image provided by the user, including the founder/co-founder text (use the entire image). After a brief load, transition to the app.

Create and apply a coherent visual theme for OmniStream (colors, typography, layout) with a distinct modern streaming style, consistently applied across all pages. Do not use a blue/purple-dominant palette.
Render generated/processed images as static frontend assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them in the UI (splash screen).
Surface OmniStream Discord community information in the app UI using the provided Discord server name and contact username: server "ommistream" and user/contact "scottiscool".
Make the guest experience explicit in the UI: when the user is not authenticated, clearly indicate they are browsing as a guest and that uploading/posting requires signing in.

Add a basic "Go Live" capability as a first MVP: allow authenticated users to create and end a live session (metadata-only), and allow all users (including guests) to browse a list of live sessions and view a live session details page.

Add a signed-in-only floating “+” action button fixed to the bottom-right of the app that opens a small menu with three actions: “Upload Video”, “Upload Short”, and “Go Live”. Selecting an action must navigate the user to the correct existing page/flow to complete that action.

Update the Watch-page viewer timer UI to use a simple clock-style time-range selector (“from” time and “to” time) instead of raw minutes/seconds inputs. The timer must compute the countdown duration from the selected range and still pause the video automatically when it reaches zero.
Add a clear Shorts-specific branding element that says “Shorts” and visually indicates users can watch Shorts on the Shorts page header area (text-based; no new image required unless necessary).

Ensure the Live sessions browsing experience updates with a maximum refresh delay of 5 seconds by polling/refetching active live sessions at an interval of 5 seconds or less while the Live page is open.

Fix the current media upload/posting failure so that authenticated users can successfully upload videos/shorts and see the uploaded item appear in the appropriate feed (Videos/Home and Shorts) immediately after upload.
Add a “For You” browsing experience that shows a mixed feed of both Shorts and long Videos together, with the page/header label explicitly reading “For You”.
Allow users to start the existing upload flow directly from within the Watch experience (while watching a video or a short).
Show the current local clock time in the Watch/timer area so users can see what time it is while setting the Viewer Timer “From” and “To” times.

Add a clear, repo-local deployment setup and documentation to deploy OmniStream to the Internet Computer mainnet so the website is publicly accessible (frontend assets served publicly, backend canister deployed, and Internet Identity sign-in works on mainnet).

Ensure the frontend build configuration and asset routing are compatible with being served from an Internet Computer assets canister (including correct base paths for SPA routing) so deep links (e.g., Watch page URLs) work when accessed directly on the deployed site.
Fix the Watch page so the Viewer Timer UI is clearly visible and usable for all users on common screen sizes (mobile + desktop), including when the Watch page is reached via deep links.

Fix and harden the deployed-site access path so users do not encounter the gateway error “Canister ID Not Resolved” when opening the correct icp0.io URL for the deployed OmniStream frontend assets canister.

Add a user-facing error state in the frontend for when the app cannot reach the backend canister (or cannot create/use the actor), so the UI shows a clear English message describing that the service is temporarily unavailable instead of failing silently.
Update the backend UploadError type and returned error values to include a distinct error case for Shorts that are under 3 seconds, and ensure the frontend can decode it via generated types/bindings.
Add client-side validation in the upload UI so users cannot submit a Short upload when the detected duration is under 3 seconds, and show clear English user-facing feedback explaining the rule.
Add the Internet Computer custom-domain allowlist file to the frontend static assets so the deployed assets canister can serve OmniStream on the custom domain ommistream.net.
Update the frontend environment configuration example to include the recommended Internet Identity derivation origin setting for the custom domain ommistream.net.

Improve the backend-unavailable error banner guidance so it mentions both the icp0.io canister URL format and the custom domain ommistream.net as valid access paths, and provides a clear English hint that a misconfigured custom domain can cause access failures.

new_feature_requests.summary: OmniStream core video-sharing site where users can post/upload their own videos and shorts with titles
Support both long-form videos and short vertical videos (Shorts)
Start site with no videos (initially empty library)
Splash/loading screen that displays the uploaded OmniStream logo image including founder/co-founder text
Enforce max video length of 24 hours for uploads
Show video time/duration while watching
Viewer timer feature that can be set while watching; when it goes off it pauses the video
Allow guest access: unauthenticated users can browse as a guest but cannot upload/post until signed in
Add Live/Go Live capability (live streaming) to OmniStream
Surface OmniStream Discord community info (server: "ommistream", user/contact: "scottiscool") somewhere in the app (e.g., footer/about)
Add a signed-in-only floating bottom-right + button that opens a menu for: Upload Video, Upload Short, and Go Live
Update viewer timer UI to use a simple clock-style selector where the user sets a time range (from this time to this time)
Add a Shorts-specific logo/branding element that says "Shorts" and indicates users can watch Shorts
Implement live streaming with end-to-end delay capped at 5 seconds or less
Remove/avoid using backend actors (Motoko canister actor) for posting videos; app should work without actor-based storage
Allow users to post/upload videos from within the watching experience (while watching videos/shorts)
Add a "For You" feed/page label that shows a mixed feed of both Shorts and long videos
Show the current clock time in the watch/timer area so users can see what time it is while setting the viewer timer range
Deploy/publish the OmniStream website so it is publicly accessible (make the website go live)

Update the repo-local mainnet deployment documentation to explicitly explain which deployed canister URL must be used for the public website, how to obtain it after deployment, and what a correct URL looks like (including hash-routing examples). Use English for all user-facing text.
Enforce a minimum Shorts duration of 3 seconds (prevent uploading/posting Shorts under 3s)
Enforce a minimum duration of 3 seconds for media uploaded as Shorts so that Shorts with durationSeconds < 3 are rejected by the backend upload API.
Configure and document custom domain setup so OmniStream is reachable at ommistream.net (final public URL)

Update the repo-local mainnet deployment documentation to include a dedicated section for configuring OmniStream to be reachable at the custom domain ommistream.net, including the exact steps a user must perform outside the repo (DNS) and inside the repo (deploying the .well-known/ic-domains asset). Use English for all user-facing text.
